parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The password initialization method. Set the value to random,

*   which indicates that the password is randomly generated.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the organization. The value can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the account. The display name can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The name of the account. The name can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), at signs (@), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: EmailVerified
parameters.description: The description of the account. The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitIds
parameters.description: Specifies whether the mobile phone number is a trusted mobile phone number. This parameter is required if the PhoneNumber parameter is specified. If you have no special business requirements, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the account. For more information,view the password policyof the instanceinthe IDaaS console.

parameters.name: PhoneNumberVerified
parameters.description: The email address of the user who owns the account. The email address prefix can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PhoneRegion
parameters.description: The IDs of organizational units to which the account belongs. An account can belong to multiple organizational units.

parameters.name: UserExternalId
parameters.description: The display name of the account. The display name can be up to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The name of the extended field. You must create the extended field in advance. To create an extended field, log on to the IDaaS console. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Accounts > Extended Fields, and then click Create Field on the Extended Fields page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --username user_001 --display-name name_001 --password 123456 --phone-region 86 --phone-number 12345678901 --phone-number-verified true --email example@example.com --email-verified true --user-external-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --primary-organizational-unit-id ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --organizational-unit-ids ou_adz2vmgiwpo4tu6jtss3mynjji --description description_text --custom-fields FieldValue=10 FieldName=age --password-initialization-config '{"PasswordForcedUpdateStatus":"enabled","PasswordInitializationType":"random","UserNotificationChannels":["sms"],"PasswordInitializationPolicyPriority":"global"}' --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateUser --region cn-hangzhou --Email 'example@example.com' --Description description_text --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PhoneNumberVerified true --PasswordInitializationConfig.UserNotificationChannels.1 sms --PasswordInitializationConfig.PasswordInitializationPolicyPriority global --PasswordInitializationConfig.PasswordInitializationType random --OrganizationalUnitIds.1 ou_adz2vmgiwpo4tu6jtss3mynjji --CustomFields.1.FieldValue 10 --EmailVerified true --CustomFields.1.FieldName age --Username user_001 --PasswordInitializationConfig.PasswordForcedUpdateStatus enabled --DisplayName name_001 --PrimaryOrganizationalUnitId ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --PhoneNumber 12345678901 --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --UserExternalId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --Password 123456 --PhoneRegion 86 --method POST --force
